threat_event: Ransomware encrypts office endpoints, SCADA servers, the farm data hub, and the grower portal during harvest, halting automated irrigation, packing, shipping, and settlements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator remote access tool on a SCADA server with a shared account and no MFA; flat Farm 1 and Farm 2 pump-station networks; SCADA backups on the same network; untested recovery
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-12; BP-01 to BP-06, BP-12
existing_controls: MFA for office users; EDR with 24x7 MSSP on IT endpoints; write-once cloud backups in a separate account; IT/OT firewalls at headquarters and the packinghouse
treatment_plan: Broker and record vendor remote access with MFA; offline SCADA and PLC backups; segment Farm 1 and Farm 2 OT; quarterly restore tests including SCADA; ransomware tabletop 2026-11-10
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$5M (outage at peak, response, notification; insurance limit $10M)

threat_event: Attacker uses the SCADA integrator's shared remote access account to reach SCADA and change pump, fertigation, or valve settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist exploiting a supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote access tool; one shared account; no MFA; no session recording; no OT change alerting
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 SCADA and PLCs; BP-01; BP-02
existing_controls: IT/OT firewall at headquarters; HMIs in a staffed control room during the day
treatment_plan: Remove the remote tool; vendor sessions only through the access broker with named accounts, MFA, approval, and recording; security terms in the integrator contract
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: Exfiltration of HR, payroll, and H-2A files (Social Security, passport, and bank numbers, biometric templates) and grower settlement data for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personnel share readable by 48 accounts; no egress alerting; payroll exports kept in the file share; no data inventory
existing_controls: MFA; EDR; SIEM on IdP, SYS-03, and cloud logs
treatment_plan: Restrict the personnel share to HR; delete payroll exports after 90 days; egress volume alerts; data inventory; notification templates in English and Spanish
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$3M (about 600 workers and 230 staff notified, counsel, credit monitoring, grower relationship)

threat_event: Freeze protection does not start on a freeze night because SCADA automation, the single alarm dialer, or the Farm 2 radio link fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One alarm path; manual night-start procedure unwritten and untested; single radio link and internet circuit at Farm 2
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 Farm 2 pumps and weather stations; BP-02
existing_controls: Hand-Off-Auto switches at every pump; experienced Irrigation Technicians on call
treatment_plan: Standalone freeze alarm with a second notification path; written manual start procedure; freeze-night roster; test each November
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M per failed freeze night (700 acres of strawberries)

threat_event: Malware spreads from a farm office PC into the flat pump-station and fertigation network at Farm 1 or Farm 2
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Farm office and pump-station devices share one network; office Wi-Fi bridges to it at Farm 1
existing_controls: EDR on office PCs
treatment_plan: OT segmentation at Farms 1 and 2 with deny-by-default rules; separate office Wi-Fi

threat_event: Unauthorized or mistaken change to fertigation injection rates, ripening room ethylene or temperature programs, or cooling setpoints
threat_source: Insider error or attacker with OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change control or second reviewer for recipes and setpoints; no alerting on changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 fertigation skids and packinghouse controls; BP-01; BP-04
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 ID.RA-07 (benchmark); SP 800-82r3 6.2.4; N11-R01 (21 CFR 121.135 used as a voluntary checklist)
existing_controls: Mechanical maximum-rate limits on injection skids; hardwired gas detectors and shutoffs in ripening rooms; shift checks
treatment_plan: Recipe and setpoint change log approved by the Director of Irrigation or Packinghouse Manager; change alerts from OT monitoring
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources
exposure_estimate_usd: $100K-$500K (crop burn, product loss, possible food safety hold)

threat_event: SCADA servers and their local backups are encrypted together, and 31 of 68 PLC and HMI programs exist only with the integrator, so irrigation automation cannot be rebuilt within the RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly SCADA backups to a storage device on the same network; no offline copy; no company-held PLC programs; no recovery procedure
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 SCADA, PLCs, HMIs; BP-01; BP-02
existing_controls: Integrator holds program copies; Hand-Off-Auto operation
treatment_plan: Offline, versioned copies of all PLC and HMI programs and SCADA images; quarterly verification; written rebuild procedure tested with the integrator
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: Grower portal and settlement service cannot be restored within the BIA RTO after an outage or attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore never tested; development firm holds deployment knowledge
existing_controls: Write-once backups; infrastructure templates
treatment_plan: Restore test of the portal and settlement database into the recovery network; runbook from the development firm

threat_event: Privileged account takeover outside the cloud (directory, SYS-01, ERP, or SCADA administrator)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing privileged access; no access broker for these planes; SCADA engineers have no MFA
existing_controls: MFA for IdP and cloud admins; cloud just-in-time elevation
treatment_plan: Extend privileged access management to directory, SYS-01, ERP, and SCADA; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a customer payment or grower settlement by changing bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes accepted by email; settlement bank details editable in the portal
existing_controls: Dual approval for ACH release; MFA on email
treatment_plan: Call-back verification on all bank detail changes; portal bank changes require MFA and a 48-hour hold

threat_event: Grower portal account takeover or web vulnerability exposes grower data or changes settlement bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Optional MFA (31% enrolled); portal built without a secure development standard; 14 outdated libraries
existing_controls: WAF; annual penetration test; email verification
treatment_plan: Required MFA for settlement and bank functions; dependency scanning; library updates

threat_event: Settlement calculation error or unauthorized change to settlement logic misstates grower payments
threat_source: Developer or analyst error; malicious insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Settlement code changes not independently reviewed; no regression tests; grades not reconciled to packed cases
existing_controls: Settlement analysts cannot approve their own runs; dual ACH approval
treatment_plan: Company approval gate for settlement code; regression tests against prior weeks; weekly reconciliation of grades to packed cases

threat_event: FMIS vendor outage during harvest lasts longer than the harvest RTO
threat_source: Vendor service failure or attack on the vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 8 hours versus BIA 4 hours for BP-03; no tested paper fallback
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; vendor DR tested annually; paper tally cards exist
treatment_plan: Paper tally kits and training for crew leads; recovery terms at the 2027 renewal; monthly export

threat_event: Pivot manufacturer cloud service is compromised or unavailable, stopping or misdirecting remote control of the 46 Farm 3 pivots
threat_source: Attack on the vendor or vendor outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing manufacturer support access; no security terms; no SOC 2 report
existing_controls: Written manual pivot procedures at Farm 3; panel-level controls
treatment_plan: Security questionnaire and contract terms; restrict support access to on-request
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: Shared crew lead logins make field tally and harvest traceability entries unattributable, so H-2A earnings records are disputed and Produce Safety records are not signed by the person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 shared SYS-01 logins on crew tablets at Farms 1 and 2
existing_controls: Crew leads sign paper summaries weekly
treatment_plan: Named crew lead accounts with tablet PINs in kiosk mode; weekly tally edit review

threat_event: An account of a departed staff member or seasonal worker is used after departure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 mobile, SCADA, and pivot accounts removed manually and late
existing_controls: Automatic IdP disable at termination
treatment_plan: Season-end account sweep; termination checklist covers all local accounts

threat_event: Equipment dealer technicians, or an attacker using a dealer account, view or export operator location histories and machine data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing dealer access; location history kept indefinitely
existing_controls: Named company accounts
treatment_plan: On-request dealer access; 13-month location history retention; dealer terms

threat_event: Weak or default credentials on OT and IoT devices that P07 did not test (pivot modems, LoRaWAN gateways, valve controllers) are used to alter commands or sensor data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Installers leave defaults; no credential inventory
existing_controls: Some devices reachable only on private cellular APNs
treatment_plan: Credential sweep of all field device classes with the inventory work; password manager for OT
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: Attacker exploits unpatched SCADA server and HMI operating systems or PLC firmware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA last patched 2025-03; 2 HMIs on an unsupported OS; PLC firmware never updated
existing_controls: No internet or email on HMIs; IT/OT firewall
treatment_plan: Integrator-tested quarterly SCADA patching; HMI replacement in the 2027 capital plan; firmware review yearly
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: Unknown OT devices or rogue cellular modems give unmanaged paths into irrigation or packinghouse networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT inventory about 55% complete; installers add devices without telling IT
existing_controls: Partial spreadsheet inventory
treatment_plan: Passive OT discovery; installer notification rule in purchasing

threat_event: Malicious changes or intrusions in SCADA, PLCs, or packinghouse controls go undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT logs in the SIEM; no setpoint or recipe change alerts
existing_controls: IT monitoring by the MSSP
treatment_plan: Passive OT monitoring sensors at headquarters and the packinghouse feeding the SIEM; setpoint and recipe change alerts; Farms 1 and 2 after segmentation

threat_event: A cold-chain excursion is not detected because the alarm service fails or is tampered with, and spoiled or temperature-abused produce ships
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single alarm path; no manual round procedure written
existing_controls: Alarm service calls and texts shift leads
treatment_plan: Second alarm path (local horn and light); written manual rounds; monthly alarm test

threat_event: Hurricane causes multi-day loss of power and connectivity at the farms, the packinghouse, and the Irrigation Operations Center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coastal and inland Florida sites; single circuit at Farm 2; IOC without alternate site
existing_controls: Generators at headquarters and the packinghouse; cloud backups in a second region; property insurance
treatment_plan: Hurricane plan update with cyber recovery steps; satellite or cellular backup links for the IOC and Farm 2; alternate SCADA operation from the packinghouse control room

threat_event: Produce Safety, pesticide application, or H-2A records cannot be produced on time, or are found incomplete or altered, during an FDA, EPA, or DOL request or a customer audit
threat_source: Vendor outage, data loss, or record tampering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records live only in SYS-01; full export never tested; no edit review
existing_controls: Vendor backups; paper field binders
treatment_plan: Monthly full export to the backup account; quarterly 24-hour retrieval drill; retention schedule
owner: Director of Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: The company cannot produce Food Traceability Rule records as an electronic sortable spreadsheet within 24 hours when FDA begins enforcing on 2028-07-20
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key data elements split across SYS-01, SYS-10, and packing line labelers; no traceability plan document
existing_controls: Mock recalls twice a year
treatment_plan: Traceability plan; integration of harvest, packing, and shipping data in the farm data hub; spreadsheet export test
owner: Director of Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Phishing with an adversary-in-the-middle page steals an office user's password and MFA session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is not phishing-resistant; 9.1% phishing click rate
existing_controls: Number matching; conditional access; quarterly phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Token protection and phishing-resistant MFA for finance, HR, and administrators; targeted training

threat_event: A breach at one of the 38 vendors with data or system access exposes company or grower data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reviews at onboarding only; 14 Tier 1 vendors, 4 reviewed this year
existing_controls: SOC 2 reports on file for 4 Tier 1 vendors
treatment_plan: Vendor tiering and annual Tier 1 reviews (STD-03); breach notice terms

threat_event: An agricultural data vendor uses company and grower imagery and yield data to train or benchmark models for other customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Click-through terms allow secondary use; no data-use review
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Negotiated data terms with no secondary use without opt-in; deletion on exit

threat_event: The yield model over- or under-forecasts, so the company mis-sizes H-2A job orders and crew hours or over-commits volume to retail customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bias by variety and season stage found in P10; model output now used for job order planning
existing_controls: Farm Managers review estimates
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: hand-count calibration, no job order sizing from the model alone, decision log

threat_event: Automatic irrigation scheduling at Farm 3 applies wrong amounts after a model or sensor error with no human approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-apply enabled on 12 Farm 3 pivots; no plausibility limits
existing_controls: Daily review by Farm 3 irrigation staff
treatment_plan: Plausibility limits and daily approval until P10 conditions are met
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: The optical graders misgrade fruit, misstating grower settlements and treating growers unequally
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No independent grade audit; no drift monitoring
existing_controls: Grader vendor calibration each season
treatment_plan: Weekly hand-grade audit sample per grower; drift alerts; dispute process

threat_event: Staff paste worker personal data, grower prices, or the food defense plan into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved enterprise AI tool until 2026-10; no AI rules in policy before P06
existing_controls: Training message in 2025
treatment_plan: Enterprise AI assistant with no-training terms (AI-005); block consumer AI sites from company devices; POL-05 rules

threat_event: Camera-based targeted spraying misses weeds or over-applies after a model or camera fault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor model; no local accuracy checks
existing_controls: Operators watch the display; label rates set as maximums
treatment_plan: Weekly scout check of targeted passes; vendor model change notices

threat_event: A crew tablet with cached tally and worker data is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets used in fields and vehicles
existing_controls: MDM with PIN and remote wipe; device encryption
treatment_plan: Shorten offline cache to 7 days

threat_event: Biometric time clock templates or the personnel share are over-retained and then exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or disposal rule for biometric templates or personnel files; no data inventory
existing_controls: Templates stored on the clocks and in the payroll SaaS
treatment_plan: Data inventory; delete templates within 30 days of separation; restrict and purge the personnel share

threat_event: Card data is stolen at the on-farm market
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminals in a public market
existing_controls: P2PE terminals; hosted payment page; annual SAQ
treatment_plan: Accepted: card data does not enter company systems; keep P2PE and the annual SAQ

threat_event: Online store customer accounts are taken over or the e-commerce vendor is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,000 accounts; vendor MFA optional
existing_controls: Hosted payment page; no card data
treatment_plan: Breach contact registered with the vendor; enable vendor MFA for staff

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident quickly, so containment is late and notice clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Farm and packinghouse staff not trained on incident roles; no OT reporting examples
existing_controls: Service desk security line; MSSP alerts
treatment_plan: Incident reporting cards in English and Spanish; supervisor training; tabletop exercises

threat_event: Missing standards (OT, configuration, logging, vendor, secure development) leave controls inconsistent across farms and vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 standards missing or thin (gap 8)
existing_controls: 5 policies (2024, revised 2026)
treatment_plan: Issue the P06 standards on the published schedule

threat_event: An internet-facing system (VPN appliance or grower portal) is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly scanning; patch SLA met 82% of the time
existing_controls: WAF; annual penetration test; CISA advisories
treatment_plan: Monthly scans; known-exploited vulnerabilities fixed within 7 days on internet-facing systems

threat_event: RTK correction or GNSS signal is lost or degraded during planting or spraying
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 base stations; no backup corrections
existing_controls: Subscription correction service as backup on 20 machines
treatment_plan: Backup corrections on all planting and spraying machines

threat_event: The Farm 2 internet circuit or a pump-station radio link fails in season, cutting SCADA control of the pumps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single circuit at Farm 2; one radio link per farm
existing_controls: Manual pump operation
treatment_plan: Cellular backup at Farm 2 and on each radio link

threat_event: Lightning or a power surge destroys a pump-station PLC or VFD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exposed pump stations
existing_controls: Surge protection; spare PLC and VFD in stock
treatment_plan: Accepted: spares on hand and manual operation; restore programs from offline copies (R-007)
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: A disgruntled employee changes irrigation schedules or deletes records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad SYS-01 manager rights; no edit review
existing_controls: Vendor edit history; backups
treatment_plan: Role review in SYS-01; edit review (POAM-005)

threat_event: The development firm's environment is compromised and malicious code reaches the grower portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firm can deploy to production; no scanning; developers on personal laptops
existing_controls: Pipeline deployments only; MFA for developers
treatment_plan: Approval gate; managed developer devices or virtual desktops; secure development terms in the contract

threat_event: A faulty or malicious firmware update from the equipment maker disables machines in season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic updates over telematics
existing_controls: Dealer support; staggered updates on 10 machines
treatment_plan: Accepted: dealer support and manual operation; recheck at dealer contract renewal

threat_event: Drone imagery captures identifiable workers or neighbors and is kept or shared without need, or a drone with imagery is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No imagery retention before 2026-10
existing_controls: Imagery used only for crop analysis (POL-05)
treatment_plan: Accepted with the P10 conditions: 3-season retention and no analysis of people

threat_event: Flow meter or historian data used for water use permit reports is lost or altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Historian events kept 90 days locally; replica in the cloud
existing_controls: Cloud replica with daily backups
treatment_plan: Monthly reconciliation of meter readings to reports
owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources

threat_event: An acquired neighboring farm (PE growth plan) connects unmanaged systems and accounts to company networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No acquisition security checklist
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Acquisition security checklist and isolated onboarding network

threat_event: Default administrator credentials on 3 ripening room controllers and the cold storage refrigeration controller, reachable from the packinghouse office VLAN through a broad rule for the refrigeration contractor (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Factory credentials never changed; any-to-any firewall rule between office and controller VLANs
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 PR.AA-01 (benchmark); SP 800-82r3 6.2.1; N11-R01 (21 CFR 121.130 used as a voluntary checklist for ripening rooms)
existing_controls: Hardwired gas detectors and shutoffs; staffed packinghouse in season
treatment_plan: Change credentials and store them in the vault; replace the broad rule with a contractor jump host; review all controller VLAN rules
